description: One chat, by the peer's key: its lines both ways, newest first by the writer's time, as many as fill one answer; before (a writer's time, UTC milliseconds since 1970 such as 1795166400000, 0 for none) reads the lines older than it. after wins: with it, the lines newer than it, oldest first, so the first is the one right after. Answers {items: [{key: sent:seq, label: the line as json (sent, seq, at, text, receivedAt, re, refused)}], more}. The owner's alone.
